scope: Independent read-only review of the two project-card selector replacements in local-only snapshot commit 9e48d93b133a62ace8207a5a274c3ce731fa2b37. No source edit and no E2E run.
reasoning: Project cards have role=button and an exact project-name child in CardTitle; their full accessible text also includes status, description, ID and entry text. Matching the whole button accessible name exactly against only the project title can fail.
The replacement scopes an exact project-title text descendant to role=button. It retains Playwright click strictness and does not add first/nth/force or remove identity assertions.

Both helpers still require the post-click URL to end in the actual API-created projectId and the detail header button to have the exact project name. The detail header markup contains project.name inside a button.
PROJECT_NAME includes a per-run identifier in both files. Static source review supports the locator choice; actual browser uniqueness and successful navigation remain for the pending rerun.

markup_refs.observation: Card has role=button and pushes /projects/${p.id} on click.
CardTitle renders p.name as a descendant.
Detail header native button wraps span project.name.
